_role: Judge harness settings. Numbers downstream inherits these.
_k_note: Judgments per (pair, order). Total forward passes per pair = 2*k, because both orders are always judged.
_swap_note: Both AB and BA order are judged, in order to debias the model's judgement from input order.

margin._clear_note: net_margin = |n_A - n_B| / n_total across all 2*k judgments. >= clear_min AND swap_consistent => clear. Everything else => boundary. Threshold is a guess until validate.py calibrates it against docs/human_label.

validate._gates_note: src/cli.py survey refuses to run unless the current rubric version has a validation report passing these. A broken instrument must not be allowed to produce months of data.
